diagnostics.purpose: Show which NOCA plots remain after cleaning.
diagnostics.interpretation: The cleaned data contain more plots than the final CCA comparisons. Plots empty at one date and the agreed plot exclusions are shown separately.

diagnostics.purpose: Show species counts before model taxon selection.
diagnostics.interpretation: Counts reflect adult-or-regeneration presence in cleaned survey plots; they do not measure abundance.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare corrected legacy and resurvey species counts.
diagnostics.interpretation: Species differences describe cleaned surveys before cross-site harmonization and the CCA threshold.

diagnostics.purpose: Inspect consolidated occurrence counts in each site-period group.
diagnostics.interpretation: Retention requires at least 20 plots or samples in one group. The threshold is not required in every group.

diagnostics.purpose: Expose adult versus regeneration support for presence.
diagnostics.interpretation: Adult and regeneration sources contribute to presence; stem counts and macrofossil percentages are not combined as abundance.

diagnostics.purpose: Inspect taxon site confounding and temporal occupancy.
diagnostics.interpretation: This explicitly retains the 500-year occupancy sensitivity. Sparse sampling is shown; the primary tracking analysis uses 1,000 years.

diagnostics.purpose: From starting plots and core samples to the CCA.
diagnostics.interpretation: Each count shows plots or samples remaining. Reasons beside the arrows explain losses; repeated visits and sample depths combined at the same modeled age are distinguished from exclusions. The middle panels show legacy adult-tree areas among retained plots and the confirmed 500 m² resurvey area at both sites.

diagnostics.purpose: Inspect four fitted age-depth models and slump treatment.
diagnostics.interpretation: The four age-depth curves show sediment accumulation, removed instantaneous layers and modeled age ranges. Those ranges are conditional on the adopted controls and Bacon settings.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare published activity errors with assumed ±10-year age uncertainty.
diagnostics.interpretation: The sensitivity concerns the upper 35–40 cm of Panther Potholes; uncertainty in published fire chronologies is not equivalent across sites.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare selected survey windows with the full 1979–2021 record.
diagnostics.interpretation: Detrending does not resolve CHELSA product continuity. Apparent precipitation anomalies remain a scientific limitation.

diagnostics.purpose: Inspect redundancy among candidate climate variables.
diagnostics.interpretation: Only page 2 (correlations) is inline. Page 1 and associated pace tables retain the former 500-year sensitivity and are not primary rate evidence.
diagnostics.status: correlation diagnostic; full PDF includes 500-year sensitivity

diagnostics.purpose: Compare scaling 1 and 2 of the same fitted CCA.
diagnostics.interpretation: Site scaling (1), Hill off and CCA1–CCA2 define the primary geometry. Unequal rescaling of axes changes distances and angles; display arrow multipliers are excluded from the calculations.

diagnostics.purpose: Audit NOCA modern fire assignment against Wilson reference plots.
diagnostics.interpretation: The 303 shared plots agree. The cleaned 305-plot universe excludes CARI449/CARI450 for GPS problems; the Wilson reference is not substituted for it.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare fire-event detection in all four lake records.
diagnostics.interpretation: Each panel shows the charcoal residual, the local noise threshold (dashed), accepted events (filled circles), and peaks rejected by the minimum-count screen (red crosses). The three MORA records use 95% thresholds; Panther Potholes uses 99%. These events are used later to identify high-fire periods.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare official CharAnalysis results with published Walsh totals.
diagnostics.interpretation: The official CharAnalysis implementation and Walsh publication give different event totals. This comparison is separate from the primary tapas event catalog, whose thresholds were not tuned to force agreement.

diagnostics.purpose: Expose signed changes, phase support, and era construction.
diagnostics.interpretation: Any qualifying variable creates a climate-change cell. Only adjacent cells merge; the unsigned composite is context.

diagnostics.purpose: Work through centered event frequencies at 2,300 cal BP.
diagnostics.interpretation: Within-core normalization and site-specific robust thresholds yield MORA high fire and NOCA no high fire for the worked date.

diagnostics.purpose: Work through WA/LC movement, lag, ratio, and angle.
diagnostics.interpretation: One actual Panther Potholes lake transition shows WA/LC endpoints, pace/direction counterfactuals, focused responses and valid chronology-draw distributions. Corrections are nonadditive.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare tracking responses, climate and fire under established regional climate-period bands, with Anthropocene boxplots.
diagnostics.interpretation: Rows show four tracking rates together, standardized physical climate-change rate, and continuous fire activity. Four Holocene lake columns share aligned cal-BP axes and scales by row; thin lines show offsets and thick lines show complete-offset medians. Frozen Figure 2 era/subphase products supply darker CC and lighter stability bands across all Holocene rows, including CC1a/CC1b/CC1c labels and internal boundaries; margins outside the classified domain are unshaded. A fifth column shows identically colored MORA/NOCA paired-plot boxplots using separate labeled y-scales. Modern continuous fire activity is unavailable and is annotated. MORA vegetation lakes share regional fire exposure. Offsets are sensitivity placements, not independent replicates.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare magnitude tracking ratio, angle, climate and fire under the same regional climate-period bands, one variable per row.
diagnostics.interpretation: Four lake columns show magnitude tracking ratio, movement angle, standardized climate-change rate and fire activity in separate rows. The same frozen Figure 2 era/subphase products annotate all Holocene rows with darker CC and lighter stability bands, CC1 subdivisions and unshaded margins outside the classified domain. The duplicate Holocene rate-ratio display is omitted; both ratios remain in the model inputs and can differ in the Anthropocene. A fifth column shows MORA/NOCA plot boxplots with matching colors and separate labeled y-scales; modern continuous fire activity is unavailable and annotated. Thin offset trajectories and thick complete-offset medians retain actual gaps and observed ranges.

diagnostics.purpose: Retain the older product-comparison reference outside current results.
diagnostics.interpretation: This historical comparison used older product/window assumptions. It is excluded from current evidence and never refreshed by --report.

diagnostics.purpose: MA(1) fitted Holocene/Anthropocene group means and contrasts across offsets.
diagnostics.interpretation: MORA and NOCA columns show offset-specific Holocene means, one Anthropocene mean per park, and Anthropocene-minus-Holocene contrasts for all ten MA1 fits. The single modern interval is from offset 0; each fit's interval remains in the result table and each contrast uses its own fitted covariance. Bars are unadjusted 95% Satterthwaite intervals. Rows have separate y-scales; parks share a scale within each row. Units are CCA units per century. Modern means are constant because plots are reused across offsets; offsets are sensitivity realizations, not independent replicates.

diagnostics.purpose: MA(1) coefficients across all ten offsets.
diagnostics.interpretation: Only the selected MA1 covariance is shown: four coefficients at each offset for era-by-site fixed effects, with REML and separate era/site residual variances. Points show estimates and bars unadjusted 95% t intervals. Reference categories are Holocene and MORA. Offsets reuse modern plots and are alternative sensitivity fits, not independent replicates. Comparison fits remain in the calculation records.

diagnostics.purpose: MA(1) Anthropocene-minus-Holocene contrasts across offsets within each park.
diagnostics.interpretation: Only MA1 contrasts are shown, with separate MORA/NOCA panels. Positive values indicate higher Anthropocene lag-change rates. Bars show unadjusted 95% intervals with Satterthwaite degrees of freedom; park panels have separate y-scales. The ten offsets reuse modern pairs and are sensitivity fits, not independent replicates.

diagnostics.purpose: Residual checks for the selected MA(1) at every offset.
diagnostics.interpretation: Each offset row shows MA1 scatter, normal Q-Q and Holocene residual lag products. Normalized residuals account for the fitted variance/correlation structure. Lag products preserve actual within-lake gaps and exclude modern singleton series; pair counts are shown without formal tests. Only 26–30 Holocene transitions support each offset fit. Distribution and uncertainty treatment remain exploratory.

diagnostics.purpose: Compare AR1, MA1 and no temporal autocorrelation using AIC across all ten offsets.
diagnostics.interpretation: Boxes summarize within-offset delta AIC; raw values remain in the comparison CSV. Dots show each fit and lines link the same offset. Candidates within an offset share observations, fixed effects, REML and era/site residual variances. MA1 minimizes AIC at five offsets, independent residuals at four and AR1 at one; all three candidates are within two AIC units at nine offsets. The author chose MA1 for reported analyses; the small AIC differences do not uniquely identify a covariance structure.

diagnostics.purpose: MA(1) individual-lake coefficients at offset 0.
diagnostics.interpretation: Only MA1 is shown at offset 0: each Holocene lake is compared with modern responses from its own park, using era fixed effects, REML and separate residual variances by era. Bars show unadjusted 95% intervals. Triangles flag absolute correlation parameters above 0.98; Reflection Pond and Panther Potholes MA1 fits approach the boundary and are retained. MORA comparisons reuse modern plots and are overlapping sensitivities. AR1 fits remain in the calculation audit.

diagnostics.purpose: MA(1) Anthropocene-minus-Holocene lake contrasts at offset 0.

diagnostics.purpose: Offset-0 corrected lag-change contrasts
diagnostics.interpretation: Existing MA1 Anthropocene-minus-Holocene contrasts for pace- and direction-corrected lag-change rates, with 95% Satterthwaite intervals, in CCA distance per century. MORA/NOCA are blue/orange; pink/purple labels identify corrections. Stars mark unadjusted p < 0.05; nonsignificant NOCA dots, bars and numbers are faint. Numbers below bars are signed fitted-mean ratios without ratio intervals, which become unstable near zero. Responses are descriptive and chronology uncertainty is not propagated. This figure reuses the fitted results without refitting.
diagnostics.status: MA1 working specification; descriptive counterfactual responses

diagnostics.purpose: Holocene offset coefficients and R²
diagnostics.interpretation: One row per observed or corrected lag-change response, with the four coefficient panels and descriptive R² side by side across ten offsets. Coefficient bars are unadjusted 95% intervals; R² has no interval. Panels have separate scales, and offsets are alternative bin placements.

diagnostics.purpose: Holocene offset-0 and Anthropocene predictor coefficients
diagnostics.interpretation: Rows distinguish observed, pace-corrected and direction-corrected lag changes. Columns distinguish Holocene MA1, modern site-plus-burned, and the extended modern model. Predictors retain their original scales; coefficients have different units and are not directly comparable across predictors.

diagnostics.purpose: Holocene predicted lag-change trajectories
diagnostics.interpretation: One fitted line per offset over supported actual intervals, without extrapolation or averaging offsets. Grey CC/S bands and CC1 subdivisions reuse the frozen regional climate catalog. These are predicted rates, not cumulative lag levels or 100-year independent observations.

diagnostics.purpose: Descriptive R² for the predictor models
diagnostics.interpretation: Holocene offset sensitivity above, modern basic and extended fits below. R² = 1 − unweighted SSE/SST. Negative values remain visible because GLS optimizes a covariance-weighted objective, not unweighted SSE. This is in-sample descriptive performance, not validation or a significance test.

diagnostics.purpose: Predictor-model normalized residual diagnostics
diagnostics.interpretation: Response-specific Holocene Q-Q and residual/fitted pages for every offset, plus modern basic/extended diagnostics by park. Complete PDF contains nine pages; selected pages show observed-lag fits.

diagnostics.purpose: Anthropocene residual spatial pattern
diagnostics.interpretation: Projected plot maps of normalized residuals, with separate parks and specifications. Independent residuals remain the initial model; within-park Moran checks record remaining spatial dependence separately.
